title: Event envelope v1
description: Common envelope wrapping every domain event published on RabbitMQ. The payload schema is owned by the producing service. Canonical event namespaces are defined in ADR-006 / ADR-0004.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of this event instance; used by consumers for idempotency.

eventType.description: Canonical event type as <namespace>.<name>.v<version>. Only the mail, ticket, response, process, document, and notification namespaces are allowed (ADR-006); email.* and response.returned are forbidden.

eventVersion.description: Payload schema version; matches the version suffix in eventType.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp (ISO-8601) when the event occurred.

producer.description: Name of the producing service (for example, ticket-service).

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier tying related events and requests together.

causationId.description: Identifier of the event or command that caused this event, or null if none.

payload.description: Event-specific body. Its schema is defined and versioned by the producing service.
